description.value:
A handmade figurine of an unknown alien creature dangles from a clunky brass keyring. While holding or carrying the keyring, you gain a +1 item bonus to Occultism checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Identify Magic] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge], and you can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Telekinetic Hand] cantrip as an occult innate spell once per day.

Note: The item's Bulk, price and usage are listed according to SFS Rulings and Clarifications.
